name: Arcway
description: Pay a person or business a specified amount of USDC using only their email address. Provisions a Privy embedded wallet for the recipient automatically if they don't have one, then executes the transfer via Circle's Developer-Controlled Wallets on Arc. Requires an API key, sent as 'Authorization: Bearer ark_…'. A scoped reviewer key (0.5 USDC per payout, 6 req/min, own company, revocable) is available on request through the program's private review channel — contact anthonyagada2000@gmail.com. Without a key, the capability runs end to end in local mock mode; see verification/README.md, step 4. Production runs in live mode and moves real testnet USDC on Arc; verify settlement on https://testnet.arcscan.app using the walletAddress returned in the response, not the transferId.

auth.reviewerKeyAccess: A scoped reviewer key (0.5 USDC per payout, 6 req/min, own company, revocable) is available on request through the program's private review channel — contact anthonyagada2000@gmail.com.

healthCheck.note: Root (/) serves the product's human-facing landing page, so the health check is exposed at /api/health instead. It reports the deployed commit. See verification/README.md.

mockModeNote: The deployed instance runs in live mode and requires an API key. Local mock mode is the primary credential-free way to exercise the capability: no Circle, Privy or Resend credentials and no API key; transfers are simulated. See verification/README.md, step 4.
